svg.title: BPMN support escalation with an exclusive merge
svg.desc: A Requester black-box pool sends an issue to a Service message start event. Support triages it. A Known fix exclusive gateway routes Yes directly to an exclusive merge, or No through Engineering investigation before merging. Support replies, sends a message to Requester and reaches a normal end event. No parallel split or retry is shown.

g.aria-label: Solid + filled arrow = sequence flow inside a pool.
Dashed + open arrow = message flow between participants.
